meta.description: Matteo Cappelli’s portfolio: web development, business management platforms, integrations and digital products.
hero.intro: I build solutions that bring clarity to processes, people and technology.
about.title: About me
about.lead: I turn complex needs into software that is easy to use, maintain and improve.
about.intro: I’m Matteo, a full-stack developer with experience in business management software, websites, e-commerce and system integrations. I work on both the back end and the front end. I take a pragmatic approach to challenges: understand the problem, structure the information and build an effective solution.
about.experience: Over the years, I’ve worked across a wide range of sectors, from tourism to training, and from operations to financial management. I’ve learned that software quality comes as much from listening as it does from code.
skills.intro: First, how I work. Then, the tools I work with. Because a technically perfect solution that nobody understands is still just a problem that compiles.
projects.disclaimer: A selection of what I’ve helped build, while respecting client privacy.

bridgebase.description: Middleware for bulk updates across multiple e-commerce sites (PrestaShop, Shopify and WooCommerce).
bridgebase.contribution: Reading product data from multiple sources and automating bulk updates and synchronisation across e-commerce sites.

quota.alt: Editorial arrangement with a ledger, charts and coins

mineralandia.alt: Catalogued mineral collection in a wooden tray

mineralandia.contribution: Back-office dashboard, document uploads, PDF output and settings consolidation. Networking between collectors.
elica.alt: Wind turbine model with bearings and mechanical components
elica.description: Sales and exchange of spare parts for wind turbines.
elica.contribution: Back-office dashboard, product listings and a digital platform connecting buyers and sellers.
cv.intro: My career centres on custom software development: business management systems, websites, e-commerce, APIs and integrations. Beyond writing code, I focus on understanding why it’s needed and whose day it should make easier.
cv.fullstackDescription: Building and improving complex platforms, from the data model to the interface, with particular attention to back-end reliability.
cv.businessDescription: Turning operational, sales and administrative workflows into clear, measurable and maintainable digital tools.
cv.methodDescription: Stakeholder collaboration, incremental development, debugging and maintenance.

services.meta.title: Software development services | Matteo Cappelli
services.meta.description: Custom software, websites, e-commerce, integrations and automation. Digital solutions to organise your work and help your business evolve.
services.hero.eyebrow: Software development, from needs to product
services.hero.intro: I build websites, applications and custom software for businesses and professionals. I help you organise your work, connect the tools you use and turn a need into a digital solution.
services.index.label: Explore services
services.catalog.title: From everyday workflows to a complete platform.
services.catalog.intro: Every business has different needs. I can help you create new digital tools or improve the ones you already use, with solutions built around the way you work.
services.existing.eyebrow: Building on what you already have
services.existing.title: Already have software? Let’s move it forward.
services.existing.intro: I can work on existing applications to add features, fix problems and adapt workflows to new needs. Before making changes, I examine the code and how the application is used.
services.existing.item1: New features across the back end, front end and back office.
services.existing.item2: Debugging, maintenance and review of operational workflows.
services.existing.item3: Integrations, data imports and automation added to your system.
services.method.title: Analyse. Build step by step. Improve.
services.method.firstBody: We start with the people, activities and tools involved. I gather needs and constraints to structure the work and define what to build.
services.method.secondBody: I work step by step, reviewing features and how they’re used. The code should become a tool that makes sense to the people using it.
services.method.thirdBody: Using the software brings new needs to light. I can help with maintenance, debugging and the next set of features.
services.management.title: Custom business software
services.management.intro: I develop tools that simplify everyday tasks and bring information together in one place, adapting to your organisation’s processes.
services.management.item3: Features built around your business processes.
services.integrations.title: Integrations and automation
services.integrations.intro: I connect the tools you use and automate repetitive tasks, making it easier to share information and manage your work.
services.integrations.item1: Connections between software and external services.
services.commerce.title: Websites and e-commerce
services.commerce.intro: I build websites and online sales solutions to present your business, showcase what you offer and make it easy for customers to engage with you.
services.commerce.item2: Solutions for selling products and services online.
services.commerce.item3: Clear interfaces and simple purchasing journeys.
services.commerce.item4: Tools to manage and measure your online activity.
services.operations.title: Planning and organisation
services.operations.intro: I create tools to coordinate activities, people and resources, turning your organisational rules into clear, manageable workflows.
services.operations.item2: Organisation of people, resources and deadlines.
services.operations.item3: Management and simplification of operational workflows.
services.data.title: Data, analysis and reporting
services.data.intro: I organise your business information to make it accessible, understandable and useful for everyday decisions.
services.data.item1: Collection, organisation and access to information.
services.data.item2: Dashboards and reports to understand business activity.
services.platforms.title: Portals and digital platforms
services.platforms.intro: I build web platforms to manage content, provide services and connect people. Each solution takes shape around your audience and how it will be used.
services.platforms.item3: Features for sharing information and collaborating.
